account: It is day 1 at 06:00, and I have just woken at home. I have not yet seen what anyone is doing today. My schedule calls for office business at 08:00, a grain inspection at the east-bank mill at 10:00, lunch at home, council letters at 13:00, tea with my dockside neighbour at 15:00, and the office at 16:30. I should read the appointment book this morning to confirm it. Yesterday the secretary sought and received my approval for the builder's great hall lighting and table inspection today at 18:00. The secretary repeatedly said this was entered, but the schedule copy I actually read did not include it, so there is a discrepancy worth checking. I also saw oak planks appear at (-58, -60, 26) yesterday; I do not know who placed them or why. Yesterday evening I heard the innkeeper calling for my neighbour about returning an unused lantern payment. That suggests some lantern expenditure was not needed, but I do not know its circumstances or whether it relates to the hall inspection. The secretary intended to speak with Freight at the hall, though I did not witness that conversation. My neighbour reported quiet docks and no pressing news yesterday. Nothing I have directly observed establishes an emergency or wrongdoing.
